Package index

Package overview

Orientation plus the formal object and interval contracts.

pvstackr pvstackr-package
pvstackr: Stacked-Fit Calibration to Rubin/BRR-Fay Fixed-Effect Targets for Plausible Values
pvstackr_object_contracts
pvstackr Object Contracts

Declare the design

Describe a PISA-style PV design and detect PV / BRR replicate columns.

pv_design() print(<pvstackr_design>)
Declare a PISA-Style Plausible-Value Design
detect_pisa_pv_columns()
Detect PISA-Style Plausible-Value Columns
detect_pisa_brr_replicate_weights()
Detect PISA-Style BRR Replicate-Weight Columns

Assemble the target

Build the external Rubin / BRR-Fay fixed-effect target.

pv_brr_target() print(<pvstackr_brr_target>)
Assemble a Rubin/BRR-Fay Fixed-Effect Target
pv_revalidate_brr_target()
Revalidate a Legacy BRR-Fay Target Against Its Original Inputs

Fit a method

The dispatcher, the three method engines, and fitting controls.

pv_fit()
Fit a pvstackr Method
pv_fit_direct()
Fit the Direct Stacked Plausible-Value Model
pv_fit_reference()
Fit the Per-PV Bayesian/Backend Reference Method
pv_fit_stack_psis()
Fit the PSIS-Reweighted Stacked Method
pv_control() print(<pvstackr_control>)
Construct pvstackr Fitting Controls

Attach a backend

The bundled brms adapter, exported so an injected adapter can reuse it or replace one piece of it.

pv_backend_brms_fit_function() pv_backend_brms_draws_function() pv_backend_brms_sampler_diagnostics()
Bundled brms adapter for the stacked fit

Compare methods

Aligned fixed-effect comparison across methods with agreement diagnostics.

pv_compare_methods()
Compare pvstackr Method Fits

Read results

Stable accessors for the reportable estimate table, target, draws, and diagnostics.

get_estimates()
Access pvstackr Estimates
get_target()
Access pvstackr Targets
get_draws()
Access pvstackr Draws
get_diagnostics()
Access pvstackr Diagnostics

Display methods

Compact console displays for all object types; summary methods for fit and comparison objects.

print(<pvstackr_fit>) summary(<pvstackr_fit>) print(<summary.pvstackr_fit>)
Display Methods for pvstackr Fits
print(<pvstackr_method_comparison>) summary(<pvstackr_method_comparison>) print(<summary.pvstackr_method_comparison>)
Display Methods for pvstackr Method Comparisons

Migration

Reading objects written by an earlier release.

pv_migrate_legacy_psis_fit() print(<pvstackr_legacy_psis_inspection>) summary(<pvstackr_legacy_psis_inspection>) print(<summary.pvstackr_legacy_psis_inspection>)
Convert a Legacy PSIS Fit to a Safe Inspection Object
